About 7% of the human body by mass is blood (on average), meaning about 5 liters of blood in an average 70kg human. Losing in excess of 40% of your blood is almost invariably fatal, so we're looking at about 2 liters of blood loss. The average mosquito taking a blood meal until its' full will take in anywhere from 0.001mL to 0.01mL according to the American Mosquito Control Association.
